about_pullquote: We fix heating problems properly, the first time, so you stay warm and trust us.
about_para_1: Lightwood Heating & Plumbing was founded on a simple idea: local families in Stoke-on-Trent deserve honest, skilled engineers who show up on time and charge fair prices. After 18 years serving the city, we've built a reputation for reliability. Our engineers are Gas Safe registered, fully trained, and committed to getting your heating or plumbing sorted—whether it's an emergency or routine maintenance.
about_para_2: Thousands of households in Stoke-on-Trent call us back because we listen, explain what needs doing, and deliver. We don't push unnecessary work or pile on hidden charges. You'll get a real engineer who cares about the job, not a salesperson in overalls. That's why most of our new customers come from referrals and repeat bookings.
reviews_heading: What Stoke Families Say About Our Heating Service

reviews.text: Boiler packed in during the freeze last January. Called Lightwood in the morning and they were here by early afternoon. Dave diagnosed a faulty pump, explained everything clearly, and had us back up and running before dinner. Fair price, no pressure. Absolute legend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Had them install a new heating system last year. From the survey to the final powerflush, they were professional and didn't rush. The boiler's running brilliantly and our bills are noticeably lower. They even tidied up properly at the end. Will use them again when the warranty expires.
reviews.author: Catherine W.

reviews.text: Always call Lightwood for our annual service. They're reliable, affordable, and never try to sell you stuff you don't need. Got to trust someone with your heating in Stoke, and these lads are the real deal.
reviews.author: Robert K.
